name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Chieftain Chicken Skewer (Polynesian Teriyaki)
whyItWorks: Lean cubed chicken breast flame-grilled to order in a mild, sweet Polynesian teriyaki glaze with zero dairy, zero breading, and zero insoluble fiber—one of the highest-protein, gentlest snacks in all of Disneyland.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Chieftain Chicken Skewer (Polynesian teriyaki) and pair with a side of steamed white rice (Spring Roll Plate rice side) or a plain Tiger Tail breadstick.
watchOuts: Do not confuse with the spicy Banyan Beef Skewer—always choose Chieftain Chicken or sweet Bengal Beef
